description: Today's AI token prices by company: each company's price index in USD per 1M tokens at the mix of tokens agents send (87% cache read, 12% input, 1% output), weighted by its models' usage, with 1-day, 1-week and 1-month changes. Give one company to also get its models' usage shares and posted input, cached input and output prices, and its estimated spend on OpenRouter. For one model's prices use get_model_prices; for past values get_price_history.

company.description: One company; omit for all listed companies.

name: get_token_prices

change_1d_pct.description: Percent change from the value 1 day earlier

change_1m_pct.description: Percent change from the value 30 days earlier

change_1w_pct.description: Percent change from the value 7 days earlier

price.description: The model's price at the mix, USD per 1M tokens

usage_share.description: Share of the company's tokens that day (0 to 1)

price.description: Latest index value, USD per 1M tokens at the mix (87% cache read, 12% input, 1% output)

updated.description: When the token prices were last calculated (ISO 8601, UTC)

title: AI token prices
